articles.title: Europa Radio Asociación Emergencias España (ERA/IRESC)
articles.description: Its mission is to strengthen community resilience and support public authorities in disaster preparedness and response by bringing together volunteers, radio amateurs and emergency professionals.

articles.title: Webinar Series: Artificial Intelligence in Disaster Management – Scope and Limitations: Theme 2
articles.description: The second theme of the webinar series will explore when and under what conditions decision-makers can trust AI outputs sufficiently to act on them in high-stakes DRR contexts.

articles.title: Serbia moves to keep small businesses running when disaster strikes
articles.description: The Serbian Chamber of Commerce and Industry is strengthening MSME disaster resilience through a UNDRR initiative funded by Italy, developing continuity tools and establishing a nationwide advisory service to support businesses

articles.title: Technical workshop in Syria advances disaster risk knowledge for inclusive multi-hazard early warning systems and anticipatory action
articles.description: A technical workshop in Syria (16–18 November 2026) advanced disaster risk knowledge and inclusive multi-hazard early warning systems, linking Early Warnings for All with the EU-funded EEPR project.

articles.title: Bonn Technical Forum 2026: Data as the lever for coherent climate action
articles.description: The Bonn Technical Forum brings together selected countries, intergovernmental organizations and partners to explore how comprehensive risk management can connect disaster risk reduction, climate adaptation and development planning around a shared understanding of risk.

articles.title: National Stakeholder Validation Workshop on Coherence and Joint Implementation for disaster risk reduction, climate action, biodiversity and resilience in Nigeria
articles.description: The consultation would unite government institutions, DRR and climate focal points, sectoral ministries and key stakeholders to build a shared understanding of priorities and intended outcomes in existing national resilience frameworks.

articles.title: Strengthening disaster preparedness and inclusive crisis response across North Africa through regional cooperation and risk knowledge
articles.description: UNDRR contributed expertise on disaster data and tsunami preparedness at a regional workshop in Cairo, bringing together five North African countries to strengthen inclusive crisis response and regional coordination.

articles.title: Somalia Disaster Management Agency (SoDMA)
articles.description: The Somali Disaster Management Agency (SoDMA) is the national disaster response and emergency management agency of the Federal Government of Somalia.

articles.title: From risk awareness to action: Iraq advances SME resilience through interactive national workshop
articles.description: A national workshop in Baghdad on 16–17 November 2026 brought together Iraqi institutions, partners, and women-led SMEs to strengthen disaster preparedness, business continuity, and an SME resilience roadmap.

articles.title: Sendai Stakeholder Engagement Mechanism (SEM) Science and Technology stakeholder group
articles.description: The S&T constituency within the SEM brings together academia, research institutions, scientists, and technical experts to integrate scientific evidence and innovation into disaster risk reduction (DRR) policies.

articles.title: Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) and United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR) strengthen cooperation on disaster risk reduction
articles.description: Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) and the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR) today signed a Statement of Intent to strengthen cooperation on disaster risk reduction and resilience across the Indian Ocean region.
